coverage: 723 day(s) on record in the store, from 2023-12-13 to 2026-10-30, covering 15157 stock(s). This page shows each stock's freshest 20 stored day(s) (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-30); the store keeps every day. A day a stock is missing from is shown as missing, never as zero
delay: Each day's file is published after that day's close, so a day appears here only once its file has been published and stored
distinction: Short volume counts the shares sold short on that one day; short interest counts the shares still owed back from all earlier short sales that have not been covered yet.
